snippet.title: Guys with Magnets – Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Guys with Magnets launches September 21, 2026 on Steam!

Use supercharged magnets to pull, repel, swing, launch, and survive strange island courses with your friends. Play online or in shared/split-screen co-op with up to 8 players, solve magnetic puzzles, and try to reach the Golden Magnet together—even when everything goes wrong.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4594370/

Developed and published by Large Fry Games.

#GuysWithMagnets #IndieGame
